name: Audio Extract
author: Brett
description: Pulls the audio out of videos on the phone into audio files (screen recordings first): the original AAC copied out as .m4a with no re-encode, or WAV when picked. Pick videos (batch), Share to AmberX, the last screen recording by voice, new screen recordings offered as they appear; trim, track pick, progress, cancel; results list with play, rename, share, delete. Plus a screen recorder with the sound apps play (no microphone) whose recordings go straight through the extractor. Runs in AmberX on Android (native AudioExtract plugin); shows a note anywhere else.
